# Acme Cloud Services -- Master Service Agreement

Halvard Systems (Customer) and Acme Cloud Services (Vendor) enter into this Master Service Agreement for managed cloud infrastructure and hosting services. The document is fictional and was generated for NorthForge testing; it records no real commercial relationship.

## Term and Renewal

The initial term of this Master Service Agreement begins on 2026-03-28 and ends on 2027-03-28. The term then renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless Halvard Systems or Acme Cloud Services delivers written notice of non-renewal at least twenty (20) days before the end of the then-current term.

## Termination

Either party may terminate this Master Service Agreement for cause if the other materially breaches it and does not cure the breach within ten (10) days of written notice. Halvard Systems may also terminate for convenience, in whole or in part, on sixty (60) days written notice to Acme Cloud Services.

## Limitation of Liability

The aggregate liability of Acme Cloud Services to Halvard Systems under this Master Service Agreement shall not exceed USD 1,500,000 across all claims, and indirect or consequential loss is excluded entirely. Liability for breach of confidentiality and for a breach of data protection obligations is not capped by this clause.

## Governing Law

This Master Service Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, excluding its conflict-of-laws rules. Halvard Systems and Acme Cloud Services submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the State of New York.

## Data Protection

Personal data processed by Acme Cloud Services on behalf of Halvard Systems is governed by the Data Protection Addendum incorporated into this Master Service Agreement. Acme Cloud Services shall keep Customer Data encrypted in transit and at rest and shall give Halvard Systems thirty (30) days notice of any new subprocessor.

## Payment Terms

Fees are due ninety (90) days after the invoice date. Halvard Systems may withhold payment of a disputed invoice line while the dispute is open, and Acme Cloud Services may charge two percent (2%) per month on undisputed overdue amounts.

## Confidentiality

Confidential Information disclosed under this Master Service Agreement remains the property of the disclosing party. Acme Cloud Services shall return or destroy the Confidential Information of Halvard Systems on request, and confidentiality obligations survive five (5) years beyond termination.

## Notices

Notices under this Master Service Agreement are effective when sent to contracts@halvard.example.com for Halvard Systems and to contracts@acmecloud.example.com for Acme Cloud Services, with delivery confirmed in writing. Either party may change its notice address by giving notice in the same way.

## Signatures

Executed by Colm Fitzgerald (Commercial Counsel) for Halvard Systems and by Rosa Alven (General Manager) for Acme Cloud Services. The signatories are fictional characters created for this synthetic corpus.
